Woman's legs and arms hold behind-the-knee grips and overlap heavily with the man's kneeling legs; several leg/arm-like columns (~x960,y440-740 and ~x1040-1115,y450-650) are hard to assign to one body. Could not confirm a leg count of 2; low confidence.
Hand on woman's far hip (~x410,y350) is only traceable to the man's far arm via an elbow circle behind her waist; likely fine, listed as a low-confidence check.
